entities.name: Margaret Thatcher
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Britain's first female Prime Minister (1979–1990), whose free-market policies of deregulation, privatization, and reduced union power reshaped the UK economy and influenced global economic policy alongside Reagan's America.
